project_name: Character model sheet, 4 turnaround views showing front, back, three-quarters, and side profile in one image of Arthur Sterling Jr., 27-year-old aristocratic British gentleman GT3 racer known as Lord of the Apex. Immaculate blonde hair with classic sharp side-parting, piercing sapphire-blue eyes, clean-shaven chiseled aristocratic jawline, confident composed gentleman smirk. Wearing a tailored bespoke Oxford navy-blue and ivory-cream racing suit with fine champagne-gold pinstripes and golden lion heraldry crest embroidery, white leather driving gloves, luxury racing boots. Holding a dark Oxford navy racing helmet with gold heraldic lion stencil under his arm. Crisp cel-shaded anime style, thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, sharp geometric shadows, neutral grey studio background
